parameters.content:
## Reply triage
Matches the incoming email to a lead by Gmail Thread ID (no match = stop). One Claude Haiku call summarises the reply, checks for a removal request and classifies it (Hot / Warm / Cold / Not interested / Auto-reply); a Switch routes on the category. If the first Anthropic account errors (credits exhausted, rate limit), the chain retries on the account-2 model. Writes Stage / Reply Category / Reply Summary, logs the reply in HubSpot and alerts Nil on Hot replies. Auto-replies change nothing. Each classified reply is appended to the Log tab.
